papers.title: Optimal Tax Policy under Inflation, Public Debt, and Political Constraints
papers.summary_zh: 本文属于「货币政策与宏观经济」领域，主题为：Optimal Tax Policy under Inflation, Public Debt, and Political Constraints。涉及关键词：Economics、Debt、Public economics。原文未提供摘要，建议通过 DOI 链接查看全文以了解具体研究方法与结论。

papers.title: Path-Explosive Behaviour in Economic Time Series: A Realization-Centred Exploratory Framework
papers.abstract: We propose a descriptive, realization-centred framework for detecting and characterising explosive and co-explosive behaviour in economic time series, which we term path-explosive behaviour. Departing from the data-generating-process (DGP) perspective that underlies recursive unit root testing, the approach operates directly on observable path properties of the realised series. Four diagnostic layers -- level geometry, growth rate dynamics, normalised curvature, and log-space behaviour -- yield statistics that discriminate between genuine self-reinforcing multiplicative growth and I(2) dynamics without distributional assumptions or asymptotic critical values. Two theoretically motivated absolute gate thresholds screen detected episodes before a composite intensity score is assigned. Co-explosive behaviour between pairs of series is assessed at the episode level through a Jaccard co-occurrence index and non-parametric intensity concordance measures. The theoretical motivation draws on the path dependence and planning irreversibility literatures to argue that, in settings where discrete institutional decisions shape growth trajectories, a realization-centred characterisation is epistemically more appropriate than a DGP-based test. A simulation study across four DGP regimes validates the framework's discriminating power and conservatism. An empirical application to real house prices, commodity prices, public debt, and Spanish tourism destinations illustrates the empirical content of the path-explosive concept and distinguishes it from speculative bubble detection.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】我们提出了一种以实现过程为中心的描述性框架，用于检测和表征经济时间序列中的爆炸性行为及共爆炸性行为，我们将这种行为称为“路径爆炸性行为”。该框架摒弃了递归单位根检验所基于的数据生成过程（DGP）视角，而是直接针对已实现序列的可观测路径特征进行分析。通过四个诊断层面——水平几何结构、增长率动态、标准化曲率以及对数空间行为——可以获取统计量，从而无需分布假设或渐近临界值即可区分真正的自我强化型乘法增长与I(2)动态。在分配综合强度得分之前，两个基于理论设定的绝对阈值用于筛选被检测到的事件。通过Jaccard共现指数和非参数强度一致性度量，可以在事件层面评估序列对之间的共爆炸性行为。这一理论依据源于路径依赖性和决策不可逆性的研究文献，认为在离散制度决策影响增长轨迹的情境下，以实现过程为中心的表征方法比基于DGP的检验更具认知合理性。通过对四种不同数据生成过程模型的模拟研究，验证了该框架的区分能力和保守性。通过对实际房价、商品价格、公共债务以及西班牙旅游目的地的实证分析，进一步展示了“路径爆炸性行为”概念的实证内涵，并将其与投机性泡沫的检测方法区分开来。。研究方法：时间序列、数值模拟。

papers.title: The Econometrics of Matching with Transferable Utility: A Progress Report
papers.abstract: Since Choo and Siow (2006), a burgeoning literature has analyzed matching markets when utility is perfectly transferable and the joint surplus is separable. We take stock of recent methodological developments in this area. Combining theoretical arguments and simulations, we show that the separable approach is reasonably robust to omitted variables and/or non-separabilities. We conclude with a caveat on data requirements and imbalanced datasets.
papers.summary_zh:
📌 研究问题：本文旨在总结自 Choo 和 Siow (2006) 以来，关于具有可转移效用和可分联合剩余的匹配市场的计量经济学方法论进展。

🔬 研究方法：作者结合理论论证和模拟，对相关方法论发展进行了系统梳理。

📊 核心发现：研究表明，可分方法对遗漏变量和非可分性具有相当强的稳健性。

💡 应用价值：该研究为匹配市场分析提供了重要见解，同时提醒研究者注意数据要求和数据不平衡问题。

papers.title: Fertility in Honduras
papers.venue: International Journal of Economics and Finance
papers.abstract: This paper investigates the determinants of fertility in Honduras, using data from the period 1991-2022. Equations are estimated to identify the role of variables from the real, monetary, and labor sectors on fertility. The results show that fertility is mainly determined by female unemployment rates, salaried employment rates, and self-employment rates, with investment and exports also playing a role. A result of particular interest is the role of the economic dynamism of other Central American countries on Honduran fertility, which highlights the existence of a regional fertility “network”.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】本文利用1991至2022年的数据，研究了洪都拉斯生育率的决定因素。通过建立方程模型，分析了实体经济、货币市场和劳动力市场各变量对生育率的影响。研究结果表明，生育率主要受女性失业率、有薪就业率以及自雇率的影响，同时投资和出口也起到一定作用。特别值得关注的是，其他中美洲国家的经济活力对洪都拉斯生育率的影响，这表明该地区存在一种生育率的“联动机制”。。

papers.title: Determinant Factors in Measuring Firms’ Innovation Capacity – The Case of Soc Trang Province, Vietnam
authors: Associate Professor, Doctor Le Thi Thu Diem
papers.venue: Journal of economics, finance and management studies
papers.abstract: For many years, industrial production as well as service and trade activities in Soc Trang Province, Vietnam generally remain weak, fragmented, and small in scale. Due to weak innovation capacity, most products are produced in a rudimentary form with very low levels of technological sophistication and product quality remains low, value added is limited, and competitiveness is weak compared to similar goods on the market. In order to enhance competitiveness, reputation, brand value, and long-term growth for both businesses and the province, this study employs a dataset collected from a survey of 200 enterprises comprising composite scale to measure firms’ innovation capacity and eight factors with their components to analyze the factors that determine the innovation capacity of enterprises in Soc Trang. The research applied Cronbach’s Alpha to test the reliability of the measurement scale, followed by exploratory factor – EFA and confirmatory factor analysis CFA to identify the factors determining the innovation capacity of firms in Soc Trang. The findings indicate that the main factors determining the innovation capacity of Soc Trang enterprises include leadership, human resources, management, governance, R&D, and others. Among these, the most important factors influencing innovation capacity are primarily related to people whether leaders possess the competence, determination, and vision for innovation, and whether employees have the capability to innovate within the firm. These research outcomes carry several policy implications, suggesting that firms need to raise the awareness of their leaders, invest in training activities, and improve the R&D capabilities of their workforce as well as their ability to adopt and apply new science and technology.
papers.summary_zh: 【资产定价】多年来，越南 Soc Trang 省的工业生产以及服务与贸易活动总体上规模较小、较为分散且发展薄弱。由于创新能力不足，大多数产品采用较为原始的生产方式，技术含量较低，产品质量也较差，附加值有限，因此与市场上类似商品相比竞争力较弱。为了提升企业及该省的竞争力、声誉和品牌价值，并实现长期发展，本研究采用了对 200 家企业进行调查所收集的数据集，通过综合指标来衡量企业的创新能力，并通过分析八个关键因素及其子要素来探究决定这些企业创新能力的因素。研究首先运用克朗巴赫α系数（Cronbach’s Alpha）检验测量工具的可靠性，随后通过探索性因子分析（EFA）和验证性因子分析（CFA）来确定影响 Soc Trang 企业创新能力的因素。研究结果表明，决定该省企业创新能力的主要因素包括领导力、人力资源、管理能力、治理结构、研发能力等。其中，对创新能力影响最大的因素主要与人相关：领导者是否具备创新所需的才能、决心和远见，以及员工是否具备在企业内部进行创新的能力。这些研究结果具有重要的政策启示意义，建议企业应提高领导者的创新意识，投资员工培训，提升研发能力，并加强员工采用和应用新科学技术的能力。。研究方法：调查数据。

papers.title: The Impact of Maternal Education on Early Childhood Development -- by Moriam Khanam, Mohammad Hajizadeh, Casey Warman
papers.abstract: This study leverages exogenous variation from a secondary school stipend program for female students in rural Bangladesh to estimate the causal effect of maternal education on early childhood development. Using data from the 2019 Bangladesh Multiple Indicator Cluster Survey, we find that the five years of stipend eligibility increase mothers' schooling by about one year. Instrumental variable estimates show that an additional year of maternal education improves early childhood development scores by 0.5 points on a scale of 0-10, with gains in overall developmental readiness (7.5 percentage points) and in the literacy–numeracy (7.7  percentage points) and physical (1.9 percentage points) domains. The results are robust across specifications. We also estimate the effects of maternal education on potential mechanisms, including children's nutrition, home learning environment, parenting practices, and use of early childhood education and care. The findings show that improvements in maternal education increase weight-for-age Z-scores, reduce stunting, improve the probability of having toys from shops, and increase the likelihood of an adult household member playing with the child. The positive effects of maternal education on children's developmental outcomes imply the importance of investment in improving educational attainment, particularly for females in low- and middle-income countries.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】本研究利用孟加拉国农村地区针对女学生的中学助学金计划所带来的人为干预效应，来评估母亲教育水平对儿童早期发展的影响。通过分析2019年孟加拉国多项指标集群调查的数据，我们发现接受助学金的五年时间使母亲的受教育年限平均增加了约一年。工具变量分析表明，母亲受教育年限每增加一年，儿童在0-10分评估量表上的早期发展得分提高0.5分，其中整体发展能力（提高7.5个百分点）、读写能力（提高7.7个百分点）以及身体发展能力（提高1.9个百分点）均有所改善。这些结果在不同研究设定下均具有稳定性。此外，我们还探讨了母亲教育对其他相关因素的影响，包括儿童的营养状况、家庭学习环境、育儿方式以及儿童是否能够接受早期教育和保育服务。研究发现，母亲教育水平的提高有助于提升儿童的体重与年龄比Z分数，减少发育迟缓现象，增加儿童从商店购买玩具的可能性，并提高家庭中成人成员与儿童互动的频率。母亲教育对儿童发展结果的积极影响凸显了投资于提升教育水平的重要性，尤其是在低收入和中等收入国家中，这一投资对女性儿童尤为重要。。研究方法：调查数据、工具变量。

papers.title: Tariffs and the Term Structure of Inflation Expectations -- by Stéphane Auray, Michael B. Devereux, Anthony M. Diercks, Aurélien Eyquem, Joon Kim
papers.abstract:
Inflation expectations derived from financial markets exhibited unprecedented dynamics in 2025: the correlation between one-year inflation swaps and one-year-ahead one-year forward rates turned significantly negative for the first time on record. We show that this decoupling occurred primarily on days when tariff news dominated market pricing, using a two-stage event classification validated by Bloomberg news trends. Standard small open-economy New Keynesian models in which tariffs generate a one-time price-level increase imply positive comovement across horizons and cannot explain this pattern. 
We explain these occurrences through the lens of an amended small open-economy New Keynesian model. Three ingredients prove critical for reproducing the observed negative conditional correlation between spot and forward inflation after tariff shocks: targeting year-on-year inflation, substantial interest-rate inertia, and persistent tariffs. Under empirically plausible calibrations, the model generates a negative correlation conditional on tariff shocks while preserving a positive unconditional correlation, suggesting that the 2025 twist in the term structure reflects expectations of a persistent policy response to trade shocks.
papers.summary_zh:
【货币政策与宏观经济】2025年，金融市场所反映的通胀预期表现出前所未有的动态变化：一年期通胀互换合约与一年期远期利率之间的相关性首次出现了显著负值。我们通过使用由彭博新闻趋势验证的两阶段事件分类方法发现，这种脱钩现象主要发生在关税相关新闻主导市场定价的时期。传统的、适用于小型开放经济体的新凯恩斯主义模型认为关税会导致一次性的价格水平上升，这些模型预测不同时间段的通胀率应呈现正相关关系，因此无法解释这一现象。

我们通过修订后的小型开放经济体新凯恩斯主义模型来解释这些现象。在该模型中，有三个关键因素对于再现关税冲击后现货通胀与远期通胀之间的负相关关系至关重要：一是将通胀目标设定为同比通胀率；二是利率具有显著的惯性；三是关税政策会持续实施。在符合实证合理性的参数设定下，该模型能够解释关税冲击条件下的负相关关系，同时仍保持通胀率之间的正无条件相关性。这表明2025年通胀期限结构的变化反映了市场对贸易冲击将引发持续政策反应的预期。。

papers.title: Optimal Insurance Menu Design under the Expected-Value Premium Principle
papers.abstract: This paper studies optimal insurance design under asymmetric information in a Stackelberg framework, where a monopolistic insurer faces uncertainty about both the insured's risk attitude, captured by a risk-aversion parameter, and the insured's risk type, characterized by the loss distribution. In particular, when the risk type is unobservable, we allow the risk-aversion parameter to depend on the risk type. We construct a menu of contracts that maximizes the mean-variance utilities of both parties under the expected-value premium principle, subject to a truth-telling constraint that ensures the truthful revelation of private information. We show that when risk attitude is private information, the optimal coverage takes the form of excess-of-loss insurance with linear pricing in terms of the risk loading (defined as the premium minus the expected loss), designed to screen risk preferences. In contrast, when risk type is unobserved, we restrict the coverage function to an excess-of-loss form and derive an ordinary differential equation that characterizes the optimal risk loading. Under mild conditions, we establish the existence and uniqueness of the solution. The results show that equilibrium contracts exhibit nonlinear pricing with decreasing risk loadings, implying that higher-risk individuals face lower risk loadings in order to induce self-selection. Finally, numerical illustrations demonstrate how parameter values and the distributions of unobserved heterogeneity affect the structure of optimal contracts and the resulting pricing schedule.
papers.summary_zh: 【保险与养老】本文研究了在斯塔克伯格（Stackelberg）框架下，存在信息不对称情况下的最优保险设计问题。在该框架中，垄断保险公司无法准确判断投保人的风险偏好（通过风险厌恶参数来衡量）以及投保人的风险类型（由损失分布决定）。当风险类型无法被观测到时，我们允许风险厌恶参数随风险类型的变化而变化。我们构建了一系列合同条款，旨在在期望价值保费原则（expected-value premium principle）的约束下，最大化双方的均值-方差效用，并确保投保人如实披露私人信息。研究结果表明：当风险偏好属于私人信息时，最优保险形式为超额损失保险（excess-of-loss insurance），其定价与风险负担（risk loading，即保费减去预期损失）呈线性关系，这种定价机制用于筛选不同风险偏好的投保人；而当风险类型无法被观测到时，保险责任被限制为超额损失形式，并推导出一个描述最优风险负担的常微分方程。在温和的假设条件下，我们证明了该解的存在性和唯一性。研究结果还表明：均衡合同下的定价具有非线性特征，即高风险投保人的风险负担较低，这一机制有助于实现投保人的自我选择（self-select...。研究方法：均衡模型。

papers.title: Convergence to collusion in algorithmic pricing
papers.abstract: Artificial intelligence algorithms are increasingly used by firms to set prices. Previous research shows that they can exhibit collusive behaviour, but how quickly they can do so has so far remained an open question. I show that a modern deep reinforcement learning model deployed to price goods in a repeated oligopolistic competition game with continuous prices converges to a collusive outcome in an amount of time that matches empirical observations, under reasonable assumptions on the length of a time step. This model shows cooperative behaviour supported by reward-punishment schemes that discourage deviations.
papers.summary_zh:
📌 研究问题：现有研究表明人工智能算法在定价中可能表现出合谋行为，但算法收敛至合谋状态的速度尚不清楚。

🔬 研究方法：该研究利用现代深度强化学习模型，在具有连续价格的重复寡头竞争博弈中模拟商品定价。

📊 核心发现：在合理的时间步长假设下，该模型在匹配实证观察的时间范围内收敛至合谋结果。

💡 应用价值：研究揭示了支持合谋行为的奖励-惩罚机制，能够有效抑制偏离行为。

papers.title: Estimating Government Worker Skills
papers.abstract: We propose a new approach to estimate government worker skills, a setting where output is hard to observe and wages may be uninformative about skills. The approach uses wages in comparable jobs in the private sector and machine learning tools to link skills to skill-related observables. We apply the approach to rich Indonesian household-level panel data from 1988-2014, showing two main applications. First, government skills have continuously declined relative to the private sector, driven by the most skilled workers ending up in the private sector. Second, the Indonesian government pays a wage premium of 43% conditional on skills.
papers.summary_zh:
📌 研究问题：针对政府产出难以观测且工资可能无法反映技能的难题，本文提出了一种新的估计方法。
🔬 研究方法：利用私营部门可比职位的工资信息结合机器学习工具，将技能与可观测特征进行关联。
📊 核心发现：研究发现，印度尼西亚政府技能相对于私营部门持续下降，且政府为具备同等技能的工人支付了43%的工资溢价。
💡 应用价值：该研究为理解公共部门的人力资本配置和薪酬结构提供了新的实证视角。

papers.title: The realized copula of volatility
papers.abstract: We study a new measure of codependency in the second moment of a continuous-time multivariate asset price process, which we name the realized copula of volatility. The statistic is based on local volatility estimates constructed from high-frequency asset returns and affords a nonparametric estimator of the empirical copula of the latent stochastic volatility. We show consistency of our estimator with in-fill asymptotic theory, either with a fixed or increasing time span. In the latter setting, we derive a functional central limit theorem for the empirical process associated with the measurement error of the time-invariant marginal copula of volatility. We also develop a goodness-of-fit test to evaluate hypothesis about the shape of the latter. In a simulation study, we demonstrate that our estimator is a good proxy of both the empirical and marginal copula of volatility, even with a moderate amount of high-frequency data recorded over a relatively short sample. The goodness-of-fit test is found to exhibit size control and excellent power. We implement our framework on high-frequency transaction data from futures contracts that track the U.S. equity and treasury bond market. A Gumbel copula is found to offer a near-perfect bind between the realized variance processes in these data.
papers.summary_zh: 【风险管理与衍生品】我们研究了一种新的共依赖性度量方法，该方法基于连续时间多变量资产价格过程的第二矩，我们将其称为“波动性的实现copula”。该统计量利用高频资产回报数据构建的局部波动性估计值，从而提供了一种非参数化的方法来估计潜在随机波动性的经验copula。我们证明了我们的估计量与填充渐近理论（in-fill asymptotic theory）的一致性，无论时间跨度是固定的还是递增的。在时间跨度递增的情况下，我们还推导出了与波动性边际copula的测量误差相关的经验过程的功能中心极限定理（functional central limit theorem）。此外，我们还开发了一种拟合优度检验（goodness-of-fit test）来评估关于波动性边际copula形状的假设。通过模拟研究，我们发现即使在相对较短的样本期内记录了适量的高频数据，我们的估计量也能很好地反映波动性的经验copula和边际copula。拟合优度检验表现出良好的尺寸控制（size control）和出色的检验功效（excellent power）。我们将该框架应用于追踪美国股票市场和国债市场的高频交易数据，研究发现Gu...。研究方法：随机过程、数值模拟。

papers.title: A Theory of Covenant Accounting Adjustment
papers.abstract: We develop an incomplete-contracting model with accounting-based covenants to study how covenant accounting adjustments are made and what properties they exhibit. Standard accounting rules (e.g., GAAP) can generate false-alarm errors or undue-optimism errors. The manager can exert costly effort to privately identify these errors and propose adjustments. If errors are not corrected, control rights may be inefficiently allocated, leading to costly renegotiation. We show that (1) adjustments always correct false-alarm errors, but correct undue-optimism errors only when their magnitude is small; and (2) the manager may expend socially wasteful effort to identify these errors. The model yields testable empirical predictions and policy implications.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】我们构建了一个包含基于会计条款的不完全契约模型，以研究会计条款调整的制定方式及其所具有的特性。标准会计规则（如GAAP）可能会产生误报误差或过度乐观的误差。管理者可能需要付出高昂的成本来私下识别这些误差并提出相应的调整措施。如果这些误差未能得到纠正，控制权可能会被低效地分配，从而导致高昂的重新谈判成本。我们的研究表明：（1）调整措施总能纠正误报误差，但只有在过度乐观误差较小时才能纠正这类误差；（2）管理者可能会为识别这些误差而耗费社会资源（即产生无谓的浪费）。该模型提供了可检验的实证预测及相应的政策建议。。
